### REQ-014: Fix lock-order deadlock between MqttRouter and esp-mqtt API lock

## Requirement

`MqttRouter::unsubscribeAll()` and `resubscribeAll()` hold `MqttRouter::mutex_` while calling `esp_mqtt_client_unsubscribe()`/`subscribe()`, which block on esp-mqtt's `MQTT_API_LOCK` (`core/mqtt_router.cpp:26-41`). The esp-mqtt task (ESP-IDF v5.5.2, `mqtt_client.c:1649` ff.) holds `MQTT_API_LOCK` while dispatching `MQTT_EVENT_DATA`, whose handler `MqttRouter::onMessage()` blocks on `MqttRouter::mutex_`. If a message arrives during a room reconfiguration (`Thermo::processJsonAsObj()` rooms flow — the standard provisioning path), both tasks deadlock permanently; the control task dies holding `Thermo::mutex_` → total freeze.

Fix: never call into `MqttClient` while holding `MqttRouter::mutex_`. Copy the topic list under the mutex, release it, then perform the broker (un)subscribes on the copy. `MqttRouter::subscribe()` already follows this pattern (`mqtt_router.cpp:15-24`).

See finding F-2 in `doc/reports/2026-07-02_migration_code_review.md`.

## Notes

Rule of thumb to document in the code: MQTT client calls are potentially blocking on `MQTT_API_LOCK` and must never happen under any application mutex that the MQTT event callback also takes.
